data.name: PageDescription
data.value: Select a global product to view its active abbreviation or submit a controlled request.

data.name: AbbreviationHelp
data.value: Enter exactly three ASCII letters. The server normalizes lowercase input.

data.name: SelectorLoadError
data.value: Global products could not be loaded.

data.name: ErrorForbidden
data.value: You are not authorized for this ABB action.

data.name: ErrorNotFound
data.value: The ABB record could not be found.

data.name: ErrorConflict
data.value: The ABB record changed. Reload and try again.

data.name: ErrorGateway
data.value: The ABB service is currently unavailable.

data.name: SelectorPermissionRequired
data.value: Selecting a product and requesting ABB require Global Product read permission. Existing ABB links and saved product views remain available without the selector.

data.name: ErrorReconciliation
data.value: The change is not fully recorded yet. Repeat the same action, unchanged, to complete it.

data.name: ErrorAlreadyAllocated
data.value: This abbreviation is already taken. Codes are never reused; choose another.

data.name: ErrorCorrectionUnchanged
data.value: The new abbreviation is the same as the current one.

data.name: ErrorRequestClosed
data.value: This code was already requested and the request is closed. Make a new request instead.

data.name: ErrorProductHasEntry
data.value: This product already has an active or pending abbreviation.

data.name: ErrorCorrectionPending
data.value: A correction of this code is already waiting for a decision.

data.name: ErrorRetirementPending
data.value: A retirement of this code is already waiting for a decision.

data.name: ErrorNotPending
data.value: This request has already been decided. Reload to see its status.

data.name: ErrorFormerNotActive
data.value: The code this correction replaces is no longer active. The correction can only be rejected or cancelled.

data.name: ErrorKeyReused
data.value: This operation was already used for another record. Reload the page and try again.

data.name: ErrorProductNotFound
data.value: The selected Global Product was not found.

data.name: ErrorCorrectionRequiresActive
data.value: Only an active code can be corrected.

data.name: ErrorRetirementRequestNotFound
data.value: This retirement request is no longer waiting for a decision.

data.name: ErrorPersistenceUnavailable
data.value: The register is temporarily unavailable. Nothing was changed; repeat the same action.

data.name: ErrorCancelNotOwner
data.value: Only the person who made the request can cancel it.

data.name: ErrorMakerChecker
data.value: The person who made a request cannot decide it.
